h1: Faster PrestaShop pages and clean search settings
overview: We make your PrestaShop store faster and easier for search engines to understand. That starts with a speed test of your key pages, then we switch on and tune PrestaShop's caching, compress images and remove modules that slow things down. For search, we fix page titles and descriptions, clean up friendly URLs, solve duplicate page problems and check your sitemap. You get before and after numbers.

faq: No. We fix speed, structure and settings so search engines can read your store clearly. Rankings also depend on content, competition and links.
Will removing modules break my store?
We test before and after, and only remove modules that are unused or clash. We keep a backup so any change can be undone.
Do you handle PrestaShop faceted search pages?
Yes. Filter pages can create many near duplicate addresses. We set rules so useful ones are indexed and the rest are kept out of search.
We fix titles, descriptions and headings. Full product copywriting is separate, but for key pages we suggest wording you can approve.
